verdict.rationale: Mercury's own features hint at recurring automation: marketing mentions 'automatic invoices' and a long-time customer describes purpose-named accounts with 'auto-funding rules'. Neither is documented as a general scheduler for recurring jobs or workflows. Running the CLI from scripts or CI pipelines would mean scheduling externally, which is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented recurring/scheduled payments or transfers, a schedule configuration (cadence, start/end) via API/CLI/MCP, scheduling of agent or workflow runs, and first-party detail on how automatic invoices and auto-funding rules recur.
